fact: Statistics Mauritius released on 25 February 2025 Issue 1838, External Trade 4th Quarter and Year 2024, with external merchandise trade statistics compiled from declarations lodged by importers and exporters at the Customs Department of the Mauritius Revenue Authority (customs declarations; 4th Quarter 2024 edition).
title: Economic and Social Indicators: External Trade, 4th Quarter 2024 (Issue 1838)
